description: Source file defining the DevicePairingApprovalPrompter class which manages device pairing approval prompts, handling user responses, and processing pairing requests and resolutions within a macOS application.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing device pairing approval dialogs, request handling, and state management for device pairing in a macOS environment.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompt handler by starting the push task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt handler, cancels ongoing tasks, resets states, and clears request queue.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the gateway server.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a new list of pairing requests, updates counts, and presents the next prompt if applicable.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks current state and presents the next pairing request alert if conditions permit.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays the device pairing alert to the user with request details.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user response to the pairing alert, managing approval, rejection, or reordering of requests.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a pairing request given its request ID.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a pairing request by request ID.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active alert, if any.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming push messages related to device pairing requests or resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pairing request to the queue if not present and triggers presentation if needed.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Updates internal state based on resolved pairing requests, removing them from the queue.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string of a pairing request's details for display purposes.
